events.title: Pisgah Rage Pre-season
events.description: Pre-season activities including social events, rider assessment, bike shop night, parent meeting, and 1-2 adventure rides in Bent Creek or Dupont

events.title: Pisgah Rage Regular Season
events.description: Regular season with races starting in March. Typically 5-6 races across North Carolina through end of May. January: 2-4 indoor training opportunities. February: 1 weekend practice per week. March-May: 2 rides per week with races on weekends.
